title: Mashbooh
what_detected: Ingredient detected whose halal status cannot be confirmed from the label alone. See BOTIA Note below for details.
why_it_matters: Under Islamic Law, food additives derived from unlawful sources are also unlawful (Codex CAC/GL 24-1997). However, food labels worldwide do not require declaring the origin of many ingredients — flavourings, emulsifiers, enzymes, and gelatins may come from animal, plant, or alcohol-based sources without this being visible on the label.
what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA cannot confirm or deny halal status. It signals that the origin is undeclared — the decision belongs to you and your religious authority.
